G:ADD:1:2026-07-28.comment: 8. MASTER GRYLLS rises out to this distance for the first time. In the money last start when second (26.49) at Ascot Park over 457m. Has been hitting the line strongly over the middle distance in last few runs. Looks the one to beat with even luck. 5. STORM'S THUNDER produced an impressive win last time in quickest of the meeting when scoring by 2 lengths (40.76) at this track. Beat some of his main rivals in latest win. 3. BUSY WORK produced an impressive win last time in quickest of the meeting when scoring by one length (41.78) at this track. This tougher but looks a leading chance again. 7. KERI JUNIOR is in the mix despite missing out at this track last time. Predicted to show early box speed and lead them into first bend.

runners.name: MASTER GRYLLS
runners.comment: Placed last time (26.49) at Ascot Park in a Class 2/3, finishing second and beaten 1.3 lengths. Has five successes and three minors from 13 starts from box 8. Looks a key chance.

runners.name: BUSY WORK
runners.comment: Good effort to win last start by one length over 681m at this track in a handy (41.78), beating Storm Junior. Worth following.

runners.name: STORM'S THUNDER
runners.comment: Good performance to win by 2 lengths at this track over 681m (40.76) beating Let Him Cook in Class 0 on July 20. Expected to measure up again.

runners.name: STORM JUNIOR
runners.comment: Modest effort last time out when fourth over 681m at this track. Tempted to look elsewhere.

runners.name: KERI JUNIOR
runners.comment: Finished sixth (30.86) last start at this track. Prior to that had recorded five minor placings in a row. Has claims on best form.

runners.name: ULTRA INSTINCT
runners.comment: Last start finished fourth in a Class 2 on July 24 over 525m at this track behind Verstappen Jewel, beaten 5.5 lengths (30.95). Prepared to just watch this time.

G:HTS:2:2026-07-28.comment: 5. SCOOBY DOOBY DOO has proven too strong with wins at his last two, scoring by 2.25 lengths (30.57) last time and by 2.5 lengths (25.89) two back. In sparkling form and a great chance to get the job done again. 6. REMMINGTON MAGIC clocked a new course and distance PB last time, finishing a 1.5 lengths second behind Dime A Dozen in 17.46. Has the ability and looks a key chance. 1. SHARK TOOTH filled a minor placing last start at Wanganui behind Scooby Dooby Doo (30.72) in a Class 1. runners.name: SCOOBY DOOBY DOO
runners.comment: Won again in another strong performance after running them ragged to make it two in a row at Wanganui over 520m (30.57). Looks well placed to make it three straight.

runners.name: REMMINGTON MAGIC
runners.comment: Jumps from box 6 for the first time after placing latest at this track (17.46) in a Class 1. Expected to prove hard to beat.

runners.name: SHARK TOOTH
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 2nd in a Class 1 on July 24 over 520m at Wanganui behind Scooby Dooby Doo beaten 2.25 lengths (30.72). Found one better last time. Leading player.

runners.name: LA VIDA LOCA
runners.comment: Good effort last time when second (17.78) over 313m at this track. Has a low draw. Looks to have turned things around so follow her up.

runners.name: HONKY TONK HIGH
runners.comment: Missed the frame last time but finished in the minors two back when second (17.60) over 313m at this track. Has ability and worth including.

runners.name: IDOL'S EYE
runners.comment: Backs up after finishing 6th on July 26 over 318m at Manukau in a Class 1. Thereabouts last time others preferred this line-up.

runners.name: GOLDSTAR COLSON
runners.comment: Has finished last in his last couple of starts, most recently at Wanganui over 305m. Doesn't profile as a likely winner.

runners.name: LUDLOW LAD
runners.comment: Last start finished eighth in a Class 1 on July 24 over 520m at Wanganui behind Scooby Dooby Doo, beaten 9 lengths (31.22). Expect improvement on the latest effort. Didn't show up last start but give him another chance.

G:ADD:2:2026-07-28.comment: 2. BOOTS MALONE comes off an average run last start when fourth at this track over 295m behind Homebush Bindi (17.90). Meets a pretty weak field and ready to return to form. 3. SASSY SKYLAR has shown good improvement at her last two starts, finishing in the money last time when 3rd at this track over 295m. Can measure up. 8. RESTLESS JACK has been settling off the speed lately, finishing seventh (18.13) last time in a Class 0 at this track. Much better than form reads on paper and cannot be left out. 5. AUSSIE BOOMER will have gained a lot of experience after two race-day starts and is not to be discarded.

runners.name: BOOTS MALONE
runners.comment: Last start finished 4th over 295m at this track beaten 1.75 lengths (17.90) behind Homebush Bindi in a Class 0 on July 20. Key chance on best form.

runners.name: AUSSIE BOOMER
runners.comment: First two runs have been average, the latest a seventh over 390m at Ascot Park. Capable of taking this out.

runners.name: SASSY SKYLAR
runners.comment: Jumps from box 3 for the first time after placing latest at this track (17.94) in a Class 0. Right in the mix again.

runners.name: RESTLESS JACK
runners.comment: Last start finished last in a Class 0 on July 20 over 295m at this track behind Homebush Bindi beaten 5 lengths (18.13). Solid formlines coming through that last run. Looks a major player.

runners.name: HOMEBUSH EILISH
runners.comment: Has finished fifth at her last couple of starts, most recently at this track over 295m. Must be included.

runners.name: POISION IVY
runners.comment: Hasn't shown any early speed lately and drifts back in her races. Last start finished seventh over 295m at this track, beaten 10 lengths. Not one of the leading chances on this occasion.

runners.name: SPICEY SPENCER
runners.comment: Has finished sixth at his last three starts, most recently over 390m at Ascot Park. Shouldn't trouble the top few hopes.

runners.name: DEBBIE JEWEL
runners.comment: Has only been in the placings once from 13 starts. Last raced when sixth over 295m at this track two weeks ago. Well placed and among the chances here.

runners.name: HOMEBUSH NOLAN
runners.comment: Has finished sixth at his last couple of starts, most recently at this track over 295m. Be tough to make an impression against this lot.

G:HTS:3:2026-07-28.comment: 4. BUILD IT BOB has been in the frame at his last two runs, most recently when third (17.65) in a Class 1 over 313m at this track. Look for sharp improvement here. 3. NEED A DOLLAR turned in a solid run last start over 520m at Wanganui finishing 4th and beaten only 3 lengths (30.79). Yet to win at the journey but has run some good races. Warrants plenty of respect. 7. JANINE BOWEN is a capable type and proved too strong last time to win by 0.8 lengths at Wanganui in a handy 30.75 beating Bumper Bill. Expecting another bold showing. 6. BLAZING CLAWS never been out of the money this track and looks an each-way chance.

runners.name: BUILD IT BOB
runners.comment: Turned in a good run last time, placing (17.65) at this track in a Class 1. Lines up from box 4 for the first time. Looks ready to win.

runners.name: JANINE BOWEN
runners.comment: Solid performance after racing just off the speed to win by 0.8 lengths at Wanganui over 520m (30.75) beating Bumper Bill in Class 1 on July 24. Capable of a good showing.

runners.name: JULIAN'S JUNGLE
runners.comment: Did a good job on debut at Manawatu to win by 1.5 lengths in 26.08, beating I'm Unstoppable. Last start finished 4th in a Class 0 on July 21 over 313m at this track behind Smuggled In Rio beaten 17 lengths (18.59). Hard to have this time.

runners.name: NEED A DOLLAR
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 4th in a Class 1 on July 24 over 520m at Wanganui behind Scooby Dooby Doo beaten 3 lengths (30.79). Leading chance who should prove hard to beat.

runners.name: BLAZING CLAWS
runners.comment: Form has been good with a placing two starts ago and a win three runs back. Last time out finished 3rd on July 24 over 520m at Wanganui behind Scooby Dooby Doo beaten 2.5 lengths (30.75) in a Class 1. Rates among the chances this time.

runners.name: SIDE SWIPE
runners.comment: Has been out of the money of late. Could only manage seventh last time out over 313m at this track. Not one of the leading chances on this occasion.

runners.name: BIG TIME SLIM
runners.comment: Has finished sixth at his last couple of starts, most recently at this track over 313m. Prepared to risk on this occasion.

HOPES ARE HIGH missed the frame last time when fifth (17.77) at this track but prior to that had two placings in a row. Better than the latest run and deserves another chance. 4. runners.name: DIAMOND VIENNA
runners.comment: Missed the frame latest (31.51) when fourth over 525m at this track in a Class 1. Has three successes and seven minors from 20 starts from box 8. Makes strong appeal.

runners.name: SIDE EYE
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage sixth last time out over 295m at this track. Tested under these conditions.

runners.name: HOMEBUSH DELIGHT
runners.comment: Last start finished 3rd over 305m at Wanganui beaten 3.5 lengths (18.28) behind Hot League in a Class 1 on June 26. Has the ability and right in the mix.

runners.name: CALVIN JEWEL
runners.comment: Has hit the frame the last two starts, the latest when third (17.67) over 295m at this track. Has a low draw. Should be around the mark.

runners.name: HOMEBUSH RORY
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time (22.27) at Manawatu in a Class 1, finishing sixth and beaten 7 lengths. Goes well out of this box with a win and four minors. Has ability and should be around the money.

runners.name: HOPES ARE HIGH
runners.comment: Last start finished 5th in a Class 1 on July 20 over 295m at this track behind Homebush Murphy beaten 4.5 lengths (17.77). Capable of improvement on latest effort. Has the ability to take this out.

runners.name: QUINNIE'S MAGIC
runners.comment: Got back last start and could only manage sixth but before that won easily by 3.5 lengths at this track (17.36) beating No Mistake in a Class 0 on July 13. Well placed and among the chances here.

runners.name: TELLTALE TOMMY
runners.comment: Hasn't shown anything recently, all starting at big odds. This looks too tough.

runners.name: CHATTERBOX CLEO
runners.comment: Has struggled to find form of late. Last raced when sixth over 295m at this track eight days ago. This looks too tough.

G:HTS:4:2026-07-28.comment: 2. OPAWA SIMPSON is progressing well with another good run last time, placing (17.32) last time out at this track. Form here sound including three wins. Goes very well from this draw with six wins and eight minor placings from 15 starts. Must come into calculations. 8. STAR BOY EXPRESS ran a useful 17.38 when filling a minor placing over 313m at this track last start. Not electric from the boxes but hits the line powerfully. Was out of the placings last time (31.50) at Manukau in a Class 5, finishing sixth and beaten 7 lengths. Will appreciate a return to this venue and looks one of the main chances. 4. BLAZING MAEVE is a course and distance winner who must be respected. Beat her main danger here last start.

runners.name: DIAMOND FRANKIE
runners.comment: Well fancied last start but could only manage sixth over 527m at Manukau in 31.50. Had been going well prior to that. Can feature with the right run.

runners.name: STAR BOY EXPRESS
runners.comment: Snuck into the minor money last time when a 2.75 lengths third at this track but did record a swift 17.38 over the 313m journey. Looks well placed and should feature.

runners.name: OPAWA SIMPSON
runners.comment: In the money last time at this track (17.32) in a Class 5, finishing a 2 length second. Goes very well off the draw boasting six wins and eight places from 15 starts. Forward showing expected.

runners.name: MORE AIRFLOW
runners.comment: Missed the frame latest (26.26) when eighth over 457m at Manawatu in a Class 5 FIN. Still a maiden from the draw but has placed four times. Looking to others.

runners.name: BLAZING MAEVE
runners.comment: Solid performance to win by 2 lengths at this track over 313m (17.18) beating Opawa Simpson in Class 5 on July 21. Consistent record from this draw. Solid chance.

runners.name: HEY DRIVER
runners.comment: Missed the frame last time but was in the minors two on end prior to that, the most recent when third (26.18) at big odds over 457m at Manawatu. Others have better credentials.

runners.name: BACARDI NIGHT
runners.comment: Didn't make the placings last time at this track (17.59) in a Class 5, finishing a 6 length sixth. Goes very well from the draw boasting four victories and two places from 11 starts. Tough field and appears tested.

G:ADD:4:2026-07-28.comment: 6. PRUSSIAN DOLL has shown good speed at her last couple and filled minor placings, last time finishing second beaten 1.3 lengths (17.37). SIDELINE SASHA is a last-start placegetter here at this trip - worth considering.

runners.name: SIDELINE SASHA
runners.comment: Has been in the minor money the last two runs, the latest at big odds finishing third (17.73) at this track. Drawn wide. Sure to play a big role.

runners.name: ROWDY JEWEL
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 6th on July 20 over 295m at this track behind Homebush Murphy beaten 6 lengths (17.86) in a Class 1. Not far away last start. Has claims on best form.

runners.name: PRUSSIAN DOLL
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 2nd on July 20 over 295m at this track behind Christian Jewel beaten 1.3 lengths (17.37) in a Class 1. Has clocked a superb 17.09 Best Time here at the trip. Key chance again.

runners.name: ONLY NUGGET
runners.comment: Didn't make the placings last time at Ascot Park (27.37) in a Class 1, finishing a 9 length seventh. Has seven successes and 16 minors from 40 starts from box 2. Place claims.

runners.name: OUR ECHO
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 5th over 295m at this track beaten 6 lengths (17.76) behind Christian Jewel in a Class 1 on July 20. Had been in strong form, hitting the frame two times on end, before the latest effort. Speedy conveyance who looks hard to beat.

runners.name: NO MISTAKE
runners.comment: Was prominent from the outset and held on well to win at this track over 295m in 17.34 last start, beating Homebush Toby. Expected to measure up again.

runners.name: HOMEBUSH BINDI
runners.comment: Found the going tougher last start when second over 390m at Ascot Park. That followed a win two back in 17.77 beating Homebush Fern over 295m at this track. Looking to others this time.

runners.name: TELLTALE TOMMY
runners.comment: Has been out of the money of late. Could only manage sixth last time out over 457m at Ascot Park. Other runners look much more appealing.

runners.name: CHATTERBOX CLEO
runners.comment: Has a maiden win to her credit but has been finding it hard to feature subsequently. Last raced when sixth over 295m at this track eight days ago. Will be tested in this company.

runners.name: AXEL BREAKER

runners.name: LEGEND BLUE BUZZ
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage fourth last time out over 342m at this track. This will test.

runners.name: GET THEM JIMMY
runners.comment: Last start was on debut when he finished last in a Maiden on July 15 over 300m at Murray Bridge Straight behind Zinfandel Zoom beaten 13 lengths (18.16). The form from his last run is stacking up nicely. Follow up.

runners.name: CRUSTY DUSTY
runners.comment: Has finished fifth at his last couple of starts, most recently at this track over 342m. Hard to recommend this time.

runners.name: ACHILLES LEGEND
runners.comment: Suited by inside box. Latest effort finished 4th in a Maiden on July 12 over 400m at Gawler behind Speed Raider beaten 11 lengths (23.69). Thereabouts at the last couple. Suited here and likely to run well.

runners.name: WHIP LASHES FURY
runners.comment: Last start finished sixth on July 21 over 342m at this track behind Cool It Buddy, beaten 14 lengths (21.30) in a Maiden. Not likely to feature on this occasion.

G:HTS:5:2026-07-28.comment: 8. LOVEABLE ROGUE has been a in top form recording back to back wins and both in best of the card, going 17.08 two back before 17.15 last time. Ran the fastest time on the program in his latest win. Is the king of this venue and the one they all have to beat. 3. NOT OKAY showed little early speed at his last couple, the latest finishing fifth (21.44) in a Class 5 at Manawatu. Has a strong winning record here. SUNBIRD STRIKER has been settling off the speed lately, finishing fifth (17.89) last time in a Class 5 at Wanganui. Form here at the trip sound including three wins. Key runner who gets his chance to atone. 7. GRASSCUTTER MOE with some luck can improve on an unplaced run last time here.

runners.name: LOVEABLE ROGUE
runners.comment: Lifted to win two runs back and got the cash again last start over 313m at this track (17.15,) beating Diamond Frankie. Looks hard to beat with even luck.

runners.name: ABBEY ROAD
runners.comment: Scored by 2.5 lengths last time (17.42) in a Class 4 over 313m at this track. Goes very well off the draw boasting six wins and two places from 12 starts. Solid win last time out but this looks tough.

runners.name: GRASSCUTTER MOE
runners.comment: Could manage only fourth last time but turned heads the start prior when she recorded a good 17.40 over 313m finishing third at this track. Suited here and expected to run well.

runners.name: NOT OKAY
runners.comment: Missed the frame latest (21.44) when fifth over 375m at Manawatu in a Class 5. Is yet to miss the placings from this box, including two wins. Bold showing expected.

runners.name: HAWKES BAY HALF
runners.comment: Missed the frame last time but was in the minors two on end prior to that, the most recent when third (21.30) over 375m at Manawatu. Prepared to risk this time.

runners.name: BIG TIME ASHTON
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time (31.08) at Wanganui in a Class 5, finishing seventh and beaten 19 lengths. Has nine successes and 11 minors from 27 starts from box 2. Others hold stronger claims.

runners.name: SUNBIRD STRIKER
runners.comment: Goes well at this track and trip. Most recent effort finished 5th in a Class 5 on July 24 over 305m at Wanganui behind Fergie's Girl beaten 3 lengths (17.89). Capable of taking this out.

G:ADD:5:2026-07-28.comment: 2. OPAWA MUFFIN was strongly supported last start when a short priced favourite and duly saluted winning by 2.75 lengths at Ascot Park in a handy 26.70. Fair draw can see a good run and has the ability and in winning form. Won at her only start from this draw. Great chance to get the job done again. 6. OPAWA WOODY has been hard to follow lately, running fourth (31.07) last time but prior to that ran very well when placed at this track. Key player on best and worth another try. 4. TURBO JEWEL is a fast beginner who has shown good improvement at his last two starts, breaking through last time at this track over 525m. The form out of the last run is proven to be strong. Expected to feature again. 5. OPAWA WINTER has been in the placings at her last two runs, most recently when third (31.47) in a Class 1 over 525m at this track. Meets an even field with many chances.

runners.name: OPAWA WOODY
runners.comment: Found some support last start but struggled and finished 4th on June 1 over 525m at this track behind Opawa Harrison beaten 5 lengths (31.07) in a Class 1 FIN. Placed two back at this track. The last run is a strong form reference. Hard to beat.

runners.name: TURBO JEWEL
runners.comment: Strong performance to post a big 6 lengths win at this track over 525m (30.69) beating Opawa Duke in Class 1 on July 20. In winning form and can measure up again.

runners.name: LET HIM BURN
runners.comment: Has been out of the money of late. Could only manage seventh last time out over 525m at this track. Will not find this easy. Down grades so keep safe.

runners.name: OPAWA MUFFIN
runners.comment: Was prominent from the outset and held on well to win at Ascot Park over 457m in 26.70 last start, beating Little Rusty. The testing material.

runners.name: OPAWA WINTER
runners.comment: Has been in the minor money the last two runs, the latest finishing third (31.47) at this track. Will need a little luck early from the draw. Right in the mix.

runners.name: VALEN VIKKERS
runners.comment: Finished third last time (17.73) over 295m at this track. Jumps from the outside. Better off looking to others.

runners.name: BROADWAY JAZZ
runners.comment: Has finished sixth at this circuit at the last two appearances, most recently when beaten 14 lengths behind Turbo Jewel over 525m. This looks too tough.

runners.name: RAVEN ZAYLEE

runners.name: SOUTH GIRLS

runners.name: TAZ MANIAC
runners.comment: Has finished fifth at his last three starts, most recently over 530m at Murray Bridge. Prepared to risk this time.

BAD PASSENGER hit the ground running and was prominent throughout but faded out of it when 8th at Wanganui in a Class 1. Has the ability to give this a shake. 2. BUMPER BILL was in the money last start and wasn’t beaten far - should feature again.

runners.name: SMUGGLED IN RIO
runners.comment: Easy winner to score by 9 lengths in a Class 0 last start at this track, clocking a solid 17.34 over the 313m trip. Looks the one to beat again.

runners.name: SHORT STUFF
runners.comment: Has finished fourth at this circuit at the last two appearances, most recently when beaten 5.5 lengths behind Just An Anomaly over 313m. Others favoured this time.

runners.name: BUMPER BILL
runners.comment: Good effort last time when second (30.81) over 520m at Wanganui. Has a low draw. The recent effort suggests he is a genuine hope.

runners.name: BAD PASSENGER
runners.comment: Latest effort finished last in a Class 1 on July 24 over 520m at Wanganui behind Janine Bowen beaten 3.5 lengths (30.99). Expected to bounce right back. Hard to beat.

runners.name: CLOUD BOOMING
runners.comment: Missed the frame last time but finished in the minors two back when third (17.64) over 313m at this track. Well placed and among the chances here.

runners.name: BIG TIME TURNER
runners.comment: Has finished fifth at her last couple of starts, most recently at Wanganui over 305m. Not up to this.

runners.name: WILD ONES
runners.comment: Came from wide draw and finished 7th on July 24 over 520m at Wanganui behind Janine Bowen beaten 2.75 lengths (30.95) in a Class 1. Likely to find this too tough.

runners.comment: Turned in a fair debut run over 340m at this track where she settled off the pace and battled on to finish fourth (19.83) and beaten 4.5 lengths. Likely to be much improved. Speedy conveyance who looks hard to beat.
